description: Gripper Gen 15: full printable handheld gripper built around the Gen 14 fingers. Jake (voice): 'I'm happy with Gen 14. Let's move forward with making it printable. Gen 15: keep that, but from the photos add the rest of it: the actual attachment mechanism and stuff, and the ability to attach a camera.' Spec: keep the Gen 14 finger shape (voice-fe67959c) as-is, only adjusting it for printability (wall thickness, tip strength, hole sizes, print orientation, tolerances at the pivots). From all the reference photos in cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_*.png, add the rest of the device: the pivot/linkage plate and finger carrier blocks, the hand-mount frame, and an Insta360 X4/X5-size camera mount on the back of the hand with the lens facing forward. Earlier asks from Jake still apply: mounting and mechanism sit ABOVE the hand, keep the thumb-index web as empty as possible; three straps (wrist, index finger, thumb) modeled as separate non-printed parts, with slots that also fit zip ties. Output printable STLs per part plus a parts list, and show the assembly in the gallery with the open/close slider and exploded view. New version only.
